verdict.rationale: Portkey offers several event-triggered automations scoped to LLM traffic: fallbacks on non-2xx status codes, automatic retries, conditional routing to different targets based on custom checks, circuit-breaker/failure handling per strategy, budget/rate-limit threshold notifications, and guardrails that can 'filter, fix, or route every LLM request as it happens.' These are genuine if/then rule mechanisms, but they are all confined to the LLM-gateway domain rather than a general-purpose rule/automation engine for arbitrary events across the platform. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader, user-defined rule builder spanning non-gateway events (e.g., custom triggers/webhooks outside LLM traffic), and independent/hands-on confirmation that these rules work reliably in production.
